settings.blacklist_help: Comma-separated keywords. Drops whose name contains any keyword are ignored. Useful for regional/exclusive drops (e.g. JP, Korea, (KR)).
settings.scheduler_help: Automatically pause and resume mining based on time of day.
settings.scheduler_times_help: Mining runs only within this window. Outside it, mining is automatically paused.

discord_bot.description: Pair a Discord bot to control TwitchDropsMiner via chat commands.

settings.blacklist_ids_help: Specific drops excluded by exact ID — added via the 🚫 button next to an active drop, or manually below. Unlike the keyword blacklist above, this matches one exact drop; other drops for the same game keep mining.
settings.blacklisted_games_help: Games listed here are never auto-added to Games to Watch by "Auto-add linked games", even if Twitch links a drop campaign for them. Removing a game from Games to Watch already does this automatically — use this list to blacklist a game directly, without adding it first.
settings.proxy_empty: Please enter a proxy URL first.
settings.auto_add_linked: Auto-add linked games to watch list
settings.idle_parallel_help: Earn channel points from multiple channels at the same time when idle.
settings.preferred_games_help: Games that are always watched — even without active drop campaigns. Auto-connects when a campaign appears. Never auto-removed.
settings.priority_list_only_help: When off, any other game with an active drop campaign is mined whenever none of your priority or preferred games is live. Your list always comes first.
settings.push_blocked: Browser notifications are blocked. Please allow them in your browser settings (click the lock icon in the address bar) and reload the page.

predictions.help: Automatically bet channel points on predictions.
predictions.bet_gap_title: Minimum gap between the top two outcomes' vote share required to place a SMART bet — if the gap is smaller, the prediction is skipped as too uncertain. Only affects the SMART strategy.
predictions.whitelist_help: Only bet on predictions in these channels. Leave empty to bet on all channels.
predictions.overrides_help: Override global prediction settings per channel. Leave a field empty to use the global value.

help.about_text: This application automatically mines timed Twitch drops without downloading stream data.
how_to_use_items: Log in with your Twitch account in a normal browser window (opened by TDM, or by the login command on a server)
The miner will automatically discover campaigns and start mining
Configure priority games in Settings to focus on what you want
Monitor progress in the Main and Inventory tabs
important_notes_items: Do not watch streams on the same account while mining
Requires linked game accounts for drops

manual.title: Manual mode active - watching specific game
